{{Quote|Ollo, hand me the Weequay servodriver, will you? Some precision work's required.|Chief engineer Lammin|<ref name="NoPrisoners" />}}
'''Ollo''' was an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] who worked in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In the [[Dantus sector/Legends|Dantus sector]]<ref name="NoPrisoners" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Ollo served aboard the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|Republic assault ship]] ''[[Leveler]]'' under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]. Within the ''Leveler's'' lower engineering deck, Ollo assisted [[Chief engineer/Legends|chief engineer]] [[Lammin]] with repairs on the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Alluvial damper|dampers]]. Upon the [[Chief/Legends|chief's]] request, Ollo handed him a [[Weequay servodriver]], a type of [[Hammer (tool)/Legends|hammer]]. Ollo then proceeded to put his fingers into his [[Ear/Legends|ears]] before Lammin began to hit a part of the machinery until it shifted into an acceptable position.<ref name="NoPrisoners" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ollo appeared in the [[2009]] novel ''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]'', written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="NoPrisoners" />
